summary: Deep Fission, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) on June 22, 2026, to disclose the completion of a public offering of 2,500,000 shares of common stock at $16.00 per share, raising $40M in gross proceeds. Underwriters have a 30-day option for an additional 375,000 shares. The company's common stock began trading on the Nasdaq Global Market under the symbol 'FISN' on June 18, 2026. Proceeds are designated for general working capital and corporate purposes, including engineering, R&D, licensing, and construction of its first pilot nuclear reactor. As a routine follow-on offering completion disclosure, this filing does not represent a special situation.
